# What A Rush Riding Stables & House of Grace

> Beachfront horseback riding, guided trail rides, horsemanship lessons, horse therapy, and beachfront palapa rental in Playa Cangrejera, La Libertad, El Salvador. Operated by Shawn and D'Arcy Burke with 30+ years of horsemanship experience.

## About

What A Rush is a beachfront horseback riding and adventure experience center located in Playa Cangrejera, La Libertad, El Salvador. We offer guided trail rides through scenic sugar cane fields, estuaries, and wooded trails, as well as horse/human therapy sessions, horsemanship training, and riding lessons for all skill levels. We also operate House of Grace, a fully furnished beachfront palapa available for short-term and long-term rental.

## Pages

- [Home](https://whatarush.org/): Main page with full information about horseback riding services, our horses, palapa rental, and booking details.

## Services

- Guided Trail Rides: 1.5-2 hour guided rides through sugar cane fields, estuaries, and wooded trails. $60 USD per session. Tack and equipment provided.
- Horse/Human Therapy Sessions: Therapeutic sessions connecting horses and humans for healing and growth. Customized packages available.
- Horsemanship Training Lessons: Learn the art of horsemanship from experienced trainers. Customized packages.
- Riding Lessons: Structured riding lessons for all skill levels. Customized packages.

## Horses

- Sir Dante: Regal, well mannered Black Beauty gelding. Calm, intuitive, and responsive — suits beginners and advanced riders alike.
- Paco: Gentle gaited Peruvian Horse, smooth ride, perfect for intermediate or first-time riders.
- Congrejeto: Elegant Friesian Horse, gentle and patient, ideal for beginners and intermediate riders.
- Tequilla: Spanish gaited horse with spirit and endurance, best for experienced equestrians.
- Victorioso: Powerful and graceful, perfect for riders seeking adventure.
- Carbonero: Wise and experienced Spanish gaited horse, steady, calm, and reliable.

## Palapa Rental (House of Grace)

Beachfront palapa rental in La Libertad, El Salvador. 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, fully furnished with Starlink internet, pool, and beach views.

- By the night: $250 USD
- By the week: $1,500 USD
- By the month: $3,700 USD
- 1-year lease: $1,500 USD/month

Amenities: Beachfront location, Starlink Internet, Pool, Fully Furnished, American Standard fixtures. Utilities included for short-term stays. Payment accepted in Cash and Bitcoin.
